A '''dispersal canister''', also known as a '''fusion disintegration canister''', was a portable device used to disintegrate matter.<ref name="GFT" /> Two Imperial saboteurs used one of these items to dispose of the dirt excavated during their attempt to bring down the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] during the [[Caamas Document Crisis]].<ref name="VOTF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>
